text_block_list.text:
I went looking for Mihono Bourbon when she 
didn't show up for training, and found her 
in the cafeteria, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—An appropriate amount? Just how many ml 
is an "appropriate amount"?

text_block_list.name: Cook Lady
text_block_list.text:
Well, it means however much tastes good to 
you! Just put in as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master... reporting in. Fatigue recovery 
confirmed via the apple dish served for 
lunch.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking it would be useful for future 
activities, I researched recipes... but 
imprecise expressions like 'to taste' or 
'a pinch' appeared frequently."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Inaccurate data is synonymous with an 
error. In fact, noise classified as 
'fidgety' has occurred within my thought 
processes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Deciding that she wouldn't be able to 
concentrate on training either, she's 
checking the exact amounts with the 
kitchen staff.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry... Distracted by the 
error, even I... engaged in erroneous 
behavior...

She seemed truly remorseful, so I told her 
we'd pick things back up tomorrow... and 
let her rest for the day.
